limitations: Retrospective known availability: the players who appeared and recorded starters define the roster. This is not a pregame lineup forecast.
Opening night has no earlier 2026-27 NBA games. Player profiles use eligible 2025-26 regular-season games and older-season fallback priors; no current-season performance is used.
There are no residual forecasts inside the preceding 60-calendar-day window. This replay has no residual calibration; it does not reuse an old fitted correction.
Team pace, defense, turnover and other team parameters remain the 575-game baseline through January 16, 2026. Updated player histories are separate.
H2H is a small, age-weighted team scoring adjustment from earlier meetings, capped at 1.5 points per team. It does not identify individual defender matchups.
Displayed shot shares are smoothed model probabilities across broad zones. Unknown two-point locations remain unlocated and are not measured coordinates.
Minute projections use earlier rotations, including DNP and known-team absence zeros; returns, new roles and offseason changes remain uncertain.
Target-game scores, shooting, box-score minutes and play-by-play are not simulation inputs. The observed final is attached only after simulation.
Approximate possessions, rotations and two-shot foul trips; no individual foul-outs, and-ones, timeouts or intentional fouling.
Court movement is illustrative, not measured tracking. This particular opener configuration has not been validated prospectively.

headToHead.baseline_definition: Mean of own prior scoring average and opponent prior points-allowed average, using only games strictly before the historical meeting Eastern date; missing team history uses the earlier league mean.
headToHead.application: Team scoring target correction, combined once with adaptive calibration before solving FG probability offsets. No final-score patch and no player/defender attribution.

scoringAdjustment.application: Bounded FG-only probability offsets; FT probabilities and final-score accounting are unchanged
scoringAdjustment.mappingCaveat: Whole-game mean response is approximate because possession allocation, rebounds and overtime are simulated.

backtest.label: The separate 2025-26 v4 research backtest uses rolling residual calibration. This opening-night replay has no recent fit and uses observed roster availability; those accuracy results do not validate this configuration.
